from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmissions(BaseModel):
    """Represents the admission data for a single university found in a document."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="The name of the university or institution")
    first_time_applicants: int = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking applicants")
    first_time_enrolled: int = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking students enrolled")
    transfer_applicants: int = Field(description="Number of transfer applicants")
    transfer_enrolled: int = Field(description="Number of transfer students enrolled")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityAdmissions]
